python -c "
import inspect
from phase1_pipeline import fetch_thermal_candidates
src = inspect.getsource(fetch_thermal_candidates)
# Check key specs from spec
checks = [
    ('API_KEY placeholder' in src or 'API_KEY' in src),
    ('B' in src and 'C' in src and 'N' in src),
    ('material_id' in src),
    ('formula_pretty' in src),
    ('bulk_modulus' in src and 'vrh' in src),
    ('band_gap' in src),
    ('dropna' in src),
]
print('Spec checks:', checks)
print('All present?', all(checks))
"
